summary: Asus Zenbook Pro Duo UX581GV System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and Limited Fan Control
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to the latest version (if available).
Install the latest Intel Graphics Driver and NVIDIA GeForce Driver.
Consider undervolting the CPU, but this requires unlocking the OC and cfg settings.
Investigate alternative methods for fan control, such as using software or hardware solutions.
